create_model_resnet: create a ResNet image feature extractor model with configurable stages and bottleneck layers
build_classifier_resnet: build a ResNet image classification model with a linear head on top of pooled features

review_resnet_forward: review the ResNet forward pass that applies embeddings, encoder stages, and adaptive pooling
